```{r}
# Clear the workspace and console.
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) 
cat("\f")

# Library packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(lsr)
```

```{r}
# read individual subject's csv file and compile
FilesList = list.files(pattern = "\\.csv$")
mergeddata <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(FilesList)) {
  fname=FilesList[i]
  subi <- read.csv(fname)
  subi <- subset(subi, trials.thisN >= 0, select = c("distractorpresence", "target_distractor", "distance", "search_resp.corr", "search_resp.rt", "ID"))
  mergeddata <- rbind(mergeddata, subi)
}

# when the distractor was absent, set the relative target-distractor location to be "NA"
mergeddata$target_distractor[mergeddata$distractorpresence == 0] <- NA
```

```{r}
# Data trimming for individual subject
alldata <- data.frame()

list <- unique(mergeddata$ID)
for (i in list) {

# Create dataframe for the ith subject
distractorpresencei <- mergeddata$distractorpresence[which(mergeddata$ID == i)]
target_distractori <- mergeddata$target_distractor[which(mergeddata$ID == i)]
distancei <- mergeddata$distance[which(mergeddata$ID == i)]
searchACCi <- mergeddata$search_resp.corr[which(mergeddata$ID == i)]
searchRTi <- mergeddata$search_resp.rt[which(mergeddata$ID == i)]

# ------------------------------ Trial Trimming ----------------------------------------

# Data trimming
# distractor absent
# cell condition data
absence_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 0 & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
absence_mean <- mean(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
absence_sd <- sd(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
absence_trimmed <- ifelse(absence_raw > absence_mean - 2*absence_sd & absence_raw < absence_mean + 2*absence_sd, absence_raw, NA)

# same + near
# cell condition data
samenear_raw <- ifelse(target_distractori == "same" & distancei == "near" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
samenear_mean <- mean(samenear_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
samenear_sd <- sd(samenear_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
samenear_trimmed <- ifelse(samenear_raw > samenear_mean - 2*samenear_sd & samenear_raw < samenear_mean + 2*samenear_sd, samenear_raw, NA)

# same + far
# cell condition data
samefar_raw <- ifelse(target_distractori == "same" & distancei == "far" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
samefar_mean <- mean(samefar_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
samefar_sd <- sd(samefar_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
samefar_trimmed <- ifelse(samefar_raw > samefar_mean - 2*samefar_sd & samefar_raw < samefar_mean + 2*samefar_sd, samefar_raw, NA)

# different + near
# cell condition data
differentnear_raw <- ifelse(target_distractori == "different" & distancei == "near" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
differentnear_mean <- mean(differentnear_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
differentnear_sd <- sd(differentnear_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
differentnear_trimmed <- ifelse(differentnear_raw > differentnear_mean - 2*differentnear_sd & differentnear_raw < differentnear_mean + 2*differentnear_sd, differentnear_raw, NA)

# different + far
# cell condition data
differentfar_raw <- ifelse(target_distractori == "different" & distancei == "far" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
differentfar_mean <- mean(differentfar_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
differentfar_sd <- sd(differentfar_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
differentfar_trimmed <- ifelse(differentfar_raw > differentfar_mean - 2*differentfar_sd & differentfar_raw < differentfar_mean + 2*differentfar_sd, differentfar_raw, NA)

# Trial Inclusion
trialinclude <- ifelse(absence_trimmed | samenear_trimmed | samefar_trimmed | differentnear_trimmed | differentfar_trimmed, 1, NA)
# total percentage of trimmed trials
proptrimmed_total <- 1 - sum(trialinclude, na.rm = T)/length(trialinclude)
# the subject's percentage of trials trimmed due to incorrect or absence of responses
proptrimmed_ACC <- 1 - mean(searchACCi)
# the subject's percentage of trials trimmed due to RT out of 2 SDs
proptrimmed_RT <- proptrimmed_total - proptrimmed_ACC

# Cell mean RT after trimming
same_near_rt <- mean(samenear_trimmed, na.rm = TRUE)
same_far_rt <- mean(samefar_trimmed, na.rm = TRUE)
diff_near_rt <- mean(differentnear_trimmed, na.rm = TRUE)
diff_far_rt <- mean(differentfar_trimmed, na.rm = TRUE)
absence_rt <- mean(absence_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
presence_rt <- mean(c(samenear_trimmed, samefar_trimmed, differentnear_trimmed, differentfar_trimmed), na.rm=TRUE)

# Cell mean accuracy
same_near_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(target_distractori == "same" & distancei == "near")])
same_far_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(target_distractori == "same" & distancei == "far")])
diff_near_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(target_distractori == "different" & distancei == "near")])
diff_far_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(target_distractori == "different" & distancei == "far")])
absence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 0)])
presence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1)])

# create data frame for the ith subject
subID <- i
trialtype <- c('same_near', 'same_far', 'different_near', 'different_far', 'disabsent', 'dispresent')
objectness <- c('same', 'same', 'different', 'different', 'NA', 'NA')
distance <- c('near', 'far', 'near', 'far', 'NA', 'NA')
RT <- c(same_near_rt, same_far_rt, diff_near_rt, diff_far_rt, absence_rt, presence_rt)
ACC <- c(same_near_acc, same_far_acc, diff_near_acc, diff_far_acc, absence_acc, presence_acc)
subimean <- data.frame(subID, trialtype, objectness, distance, RT, ACC, proptrimmed_RT, proptrimmed_ACC)
# testing whether the subject meets an overall accuracy of 80% or greater to be included in analyses
subimean$subinclude <- ifelse(mean(searchACCi) > 0.8, 1, 0)

#Add the ith subject's data to a combined dataframe
alldata <- rbind(alldata, subimean)
include <- alldata$subID[which(alldata$subinclude == 1)]
# create a new data frame with subjects who failed to meet the accuracy criterion removed
cleandata <- alldata[which(alldata$subID %in% include),]

}

# mean percentage of trials abandoned across subjects
# due to RT out of 2 SDs
mean(cleandata$proptrimmed_RT)
# due to incorrect or absentce of responses
mean(cleandata$proptrimmed_ACC)

# view summary table
cleandata %>% group_by(trialtype) %>% summarise(meanrt = mean(RT), meanacc = mean(ACC))

```

```{r}
# RT plot for all subjects
ggplot(data=cleandata, aes(x=trialtype, y=RT))+
      stat_summary(fun="mean", geom="bar", position=position_dodge())+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0.6,0.75,0.01))) +
      coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0.6,0.75)) +
      ylab("Reation Time")+ 
      xlab("Trial Type")+ 
      ggtitle("Reaction time as a function of the relative location of target to distractor")

# accuracy plot for all subjects
ggplot(data=cleandata, aes(x=trialtype, y=ACC))+
      stat_summary(fun="mean", geom="bar", position=position_dodge())+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0.9,1, .02))) +
      coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0.9,1)) +
      ylab("Accuracy")+ 
      xlab("Trial Type")+ 
      ggtitle("Accuracy as a function of the relative location of target to distractor")
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------- Statistical Analysis ----------------------------------
# ***********************RT***********************************
# ANOVA for RT
RT.aov <- anova_test(
  data = cleandata[cleandata$trialtype != "dispresent" & cleandata$trialtype != "disabsent",], dv = RT, wid = subID,
  within = c(objectness, distance), effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(RT.aov)

# --------comparing distractor present and absent--------------------

# t-test in RT comparing distractor present and absent
t.test(cleandata$RT[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$RT ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$trialtype, method = "paired")

# ***********************Accuracy***********************************
# ANOVA for accuracy
ACC.aov <- anova_test(
  data = cleandata[cleandata$trialtype != "dispresent" & cleandata$trialtype != "disabsent",], dv = ACC, wid = subID,
  within = c(objectness, distance), effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(ACC.aov)

# --------comparing distractor present and absent--------------------
# t-test in ACC comparing distractor present and absent
t.test(cleandata$ACC[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] ~ cleandata$trialtype[which(cleandata$trialtype == "dispresent" | cleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 

cohensD(subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$ACC ~ 
         subset(cleandata,cleandata$trialtype =='disabsent' | cleandata$trialtype=='dispresent')$trialtype, method = "paired")
```
